name: What are the main steps in a bathroom remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What are the main steps in a bathroom remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom remodeling proceeds through five main stages: design planning, demolition, rough-in work, finish installation, and final punch list. During rough-ins, plumbers and electricians update supply pipes, drains, vents, and wiring behind the walls before inspections occur. Next, technicians install waterproof backer board, shower pans, and moisture barriers to safeguard the structure against leaks. Once inspected and sealed, tile, cabinetry, countertops, fixtures, and trim are installed. A final walkthrough confirms all plumbing seals, caulking, and electrical components meet quality standards before project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves design planning, demolition, rough-in plumbing and electrical, waterproofing, tile and fixture installation, and a final quality inspection.
